profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Software Engineer II at Microsoft with experience designing and delivering cloud infrastructure, deployment orchestration platforms, identity systems, and full-stack web applications at scale.

At Microsoft, I work on services that enable global DevOps and infrastructure releases across Azure. My responsibilities have included technical leadership for React-based internal portals, authentication and authorization systems, monitoring platforms, deployment tooling, and cloud infrastructure migrations. I enjoy working across the full stack, from user experience and API design to platform architecture and operational excellence.

Before Microsoft, I was a software engineer within Lockheed Martin's Data Science organization, building applications and analytical tooling that supported investigations of aviation and operational datasets. My experience spans C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, SQL, cloud technologies, and distributed systems.

I hold a B.S. in Software Engineering and an M.S. in Computer Science from Rochester Institute of Technology, where I focused on machine learning, reinforcement learning, and software engineering practices.

Outside of technology, I'm a member of the Seattle Men's Chorus and enjoy skiing, paddleboarding, and exploring new technical projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Engineer II on Microsoft's Azure Core team, responsible for developing and operating cloud services used to support infrastructure and deployment workflows at scale. Technical lead for internal web platforms, authentication and authorization systems, monitoring solutions, and infrastructure modernization efforts. Drive end-to-end delivery across architecture, API design, frontend development, backend services, and operational excellence using C#, React, TypeScript, Azure, and related technologies.

positions.locationName: Rochester, New York & Fort Worth, Texas · On-site
positions.description: Worked within Lockheed Martin's RMS Data Science organization developing full-stack software and analytical tooling used to support investigations of aircraft and operational datasets. Collaborated closely with data scientists to build web applications, data visualization platforms, reusable software libraries, and database integration solutions that enabled more efficient analysis of complex data.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Worked across multiple areas of store operations, including cashiering, technology sales, inventory management, merchandising, and promotional execution. Served as the primary coordinator for weekly pricing and promotional signage updates, ensuring accurate and timely implementation throughout the store while supporting customer sales and service activities.

positions.title: Student Manager, Game Clerk
positions.description: Supported operations of the university's student recreation center, overseeing game usage, customer interactions, and facility policies. Served as a primary point of contact for students, resolving disputes, addressing complaints, and ensuring fair access to shared recreational resources. Worked to create a positive, inclusive environment that remained accessible and welcoming to all students.
positions.insights: Skills: Store Management · Inventory Management · Customer Service

positions.title: Grocery Clerk
positions.description: Provided customer service in a fast-paced retail environment, operating both traditional checkout lanes and self-checkout stations. Assisted customers with transactions, addressed concerns, and helped maintain a positive shopping experience.

honors.title: Salutatorian
honors.description: Salutation of Daniel Boone High School's graduating class of 2015 with a GPA of 100.8 or 4.03 in the scale of 4.
honors.issuer: Issued by Principal Preston McKnight · Jun 2015

honors.title: Lexus Eco Challenge Grand Prize Winner
honors.description: A group of students and I created an anaerobic digester and pushed to stop a policy to limit farmers in the amount of energy they can produce with one. Along with these, we also talked to local farmers about starting up digesters and the background knowledge behind how farms run. We got an in-depth look into a farm that is fully automated using digester energy and used it as a source to fight for the farmers who utilize this fuel source and give back to the community with extra power they produce. Overall, we won the regional prize and won the overall grand prize for the 2014-2015 Eco Challenge.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered to work ImagineRIT, helping out a stall with the intended purpose of teaching kids some fun examples of computer systems.
